## 3. Academic Phrasebank

[Academic Phrasebank](https://www.phrasebank.manchester.ac.uk/) is a free site from the University of Manchester. [Dr John Morley's page](https://www.phrasebank.manchester.ac.uk/dr-john-morley/) on that site says he created it. He is listed there as Honorary Senior Lecturer in the University Centre for Academic English.

The [About page](https://www.phrasebank.manchester.ac.uk/about-academic-phrasebank/) says the phrases were taken from real academic texts. The original set came from 100 postgraduate dissertations at Manchester. Phrases from journal articles have been added since. Most entries have had the study-specific words removed, so the line can be reused. The home page says that reuse of these generic lines is not plagiarism, and that a line still has to be adapted. Where a sample content word is left in, you replace it.

The About page cites Davis and Morley on how much wording academics were willing to see reused. The limits they report there: the reused stretch should not be a distinctive construction, should not carry another writer's view, was judged more acceptable up to about nine words, and could hold up to about four generic content words. Those are findings from that work, not a legal rule. This repository's citation rule is stricter for claims and numbers: a phrase frame does not license a finding you did not make.

On 3 November 2026 the home page had no PDF download. The article cites a 2014 PDF edition. Use the website. Do not pick up a PDF from an unrelated host.

The site has two menus.

**By part of the paper** (top menu):

| You are writing | Open | What to use the page for |
|---|---|---|
| Introduction | [Introducing work](https://www.phrasebank.manchester.ac.uk/introducing-work/) | Context, the problem or gap, definitions, the purpose of the paper, a map of the paper |
| Literature | [Referring to sources](https://www.phrasebank.manchester.ac.uk/referring-to-sources/) | How to point the reader at earlier studies. The page notes that in science the author's name is often not the grammatical subject; a number or a bracket is enough. It also notes tense: present perfect for the literature as a whole, past for one completed study |
| Methods | [Describing methods](https://www.phrasebank.manchester.ac.uk/describing-methods/) | A repeatable account of what was done. The page says most of these verbs are in the simple past |
| Results | [Reporting results](https://www.phrasebank.manchester.ac.uk/reporting-results/) | Point at a table or figure, then state the data that matter. Longer comment belongs in the discussion. The page says some journals combine Results and Discussion |
| Discussion | [Discussing findings](https://www.phrasebank.manchester.ac.uk/discussing-findings/) | Restate a result, compare, explain, note a limit, state an implication. The page says the explanation and implication lines are tentative, and it points at the cautious-language page |
| Conclusion | [Writing conclusions](https://www.phrasebank.manchester.ac.uk/writing-conclusions/) | A short look back, then a closing judgment. The page says a separate conclusion is expected more often in a dissertation than in a research article |

### 2.4 学习笔记

下面用新的句子重述这门课的主要修改规则。例句是为本仓库写的，不是讲座原文，也不是文章原文。第 1、第 2 单元的替换对，是文章说课程里反复出现的那些；同一张表和出处写在 [`clutter-words.md`](clutter-words.md)。

**第 1 单元。删掉不改变命题的词。**

读句子时标出：删掉之后，谁做了什么、对什么、结果是什么，都没有变。这些词就删。

文章把下面这些替换归到这一单元：

| 较长的写法 | 较短的写法 |
|---|---|
| in order to | to |
| due to the fact that | because |
| at the present time | now |
| has the potential to / has the ability to | can |
| a sufficient number of | enough |
| in spite of the fact that | although |

没有结果的开头也删，例如 “It was observed that”、“It is well known that”。句子仍然需要限定语气时，用一个强度合适的动词（见写作技能里的限定语气表），不要叠好几个空开头。

**第 2 单元。把真正的动作写成动词。**

常见的一种句子是：一个没有内容的动词，加上一个藏着动作的名词，例如 “conduct an evaluation of”、“perform a measurement of”、“achieve an improvement in”。动作已经在名词里。把那个词用作动词：evaluate、measure、improve。主语和动词就挨在一起，“of”“by” 的链条也会变短。

**第 2 单元。动作者属于命题的一部分时，用主动语态。**

作者团队自己做的工作，用 “We measured”“We found” 能写出谁做的，通常也比 “It was measured” 短。第 2 单元有一节单独讲 “we” 和 “I”。动作者不重要时，被动仍然可以用。论文里常见的情况是方法步骤：要说明的是操作本身，不是哪一位成员做的。第 4 节记录 Nature 现行页面、Nature Masterclasses 文章，以及本仓库自己的方法部分说明，如何处理这一点。把每一句都改成主动之前，先看目标期刊。

**第 3、第 4 单元，放在同一次修改里。** 一句承担一个命题，以及这个命题所需要的条件。不要为了变短而删掉仪器、时间点或效应量。变短来自删掉第 1 单元里的空词。段落的第一句要有这一点的内容。修改是起草之后的另一步。Coursera 第 4 单元的说明直接写了这一点。

**第 5 单元。原始研究论文每一部分要完成的事。** 按文章对该单元的概述改写：

- 引言。从领域里已经接受的事实，写到缺口或相互冲突的结果，再写到本文的问题。引言要让读者留下这个尚未回答的问题。只列文献还不是引言。
- 方法。另一个实验室应能按这一节重复工作。按时间或按实验分小标题。方法里不写讨论，也不提前写结果。
- 结果。先写发现，再在括号里写效应量、差值或 P 值，然后给出图或表的编号。不要把表里的数字再念成另一张表。
- 讨论。先回答引言提出的问题。然后与已有研究比较，并说明一致或分歧的原因。然后写本研究的限制。然后写结果在这个样本之外意味着什么。

Coursera 第 5 单元还按 2.3 的视频顺序讲了图表和摘要。文章对第 5 单元的概述没有展开这两项。

**运动科学句子的一次修改。** 例句是新写的，不是课程摘录：

> An evaluation of countermovement jump height was conducted using a force plate in order to achieve the determination of lower-limb power.

三处分开的问题：动作藏在 “evaluation” 和 “determination” 里；没有动作者；“in order to” 不增加意思。改成：

> We measured countermovement jump height on a force plate to determine lower-limb power.

结果部分用同一套规则：

> It was observed that there was an increase in session RPE after the congested fixture week.

> Session RPE increased after the congested fixture week.

有增加的幅度、比较对象和图号时，放在同一句里。没有这些数字时不要编。

讨论部分：

> The findings of the present study are indicative of the fact that the cooling vest has the ability to lower core temperature.

> The cooling vest lowered core temperature at the end of the trial (mean difference and 95% CI here; Figure N).

**后面的单元。** 现行页面的第 6 到第 8 单元包括作者署名、抄袭、掠夺性期刊、同行评审、综述、基金、推荐信、个人陈述，以及面向公众的写作。任务属于这些体裁时再看。改一篇研究论文，用第 1、第 2 和第 5 单元，已经覆盖本仓库最常使用的规则。

## 3. Academic Phrasebank

[Academic Phrasebank](https://www.phrasebank.manchester.ac.uk/) 是曼彻斯特大学的免费网站。该站的 [John Morley 页面](https://www.phrasebank.manchester.ac.uk/dr-john-morley/) 写明短语库由他创建。页面上的职务是 University Centre for Academic English 的 Honorary Senior Lecturer。

[关于页面](https://www.phrasebank.manchester.ac.uk/about-academic-phrasebank/) 写明，短语来自真实学术文本。最初的一批来自曼彻斯特大学 100 篇研究生学位论文。后来又加入期刊论文中的短语。大多数条目已经去掉与具体研究绑定的词，所以可以换到别的题目里用。首页写明，使用这些通用句段不构成抄袭，使用时仍要改写。条目里若留了示例用的实词，需要换成你自己的词。

关于页面引用了 Davis 与 Morley 关于学术作者能接受多少复用的调查。该页转述的界限是：复用的片段不应是独特的句式，不应带有另一位作者的观点，大约九个词以内更容易被接受，通用实词大约不超过四个。这是那项研究的结果，不是法律规则。本仓库对论断和数字更严：一个句式框架不能代替你没有做出的结果。

2026-11-03 的首页没有 PDF 下载。文章引用的是 2014 年的 PDF 版。使用网站。不要从无关站点下载 PDF。

网站有两套菜单。

**按论文部分**（顶部菜单）：

| 正在写的部分 | 打开 | 这一页用来做什么 |
|---|---|---|
| 引言 | [Introducing work](https://www.phrasebank.manchester.ac.uk/introducing-work/) | 背景、问题或缺口、定义、本文目的、全文结构 |
| 文献 | [Referring to sources](https://www.phrasebank.manchester.ac.uk/referring-to-sources/) | 如何把读者引向已有研究。该页说明，在理科里作者姓名常常不是句子的主语，用编号或括号即可。时态：概述文献多用现在完成时，某一项已经完成的研究用过去时 |
| 方法 | [Describing methods](https://www.phrasebank.manchester.ac.uk/describing-methods/) | 把做过的事写成可以重复的记录。该页说明，这里的动词大多用一般过去时 |
| 结果 | [Reporting results](https://www.phrasebank.manchester.ac.uk/reporting-results/) | 先指向表或图，再写出重要的数据。较长的评论放在讨论。该页说明，有的期刊把结果和讨论写在一起 |
| 讨论 | [Discussing findings](https://www.phrasebank.manchester.ac.uk/discussing-findings/) | 重述一条结果、比较、解释、写限制、写含义。该页说明，解释和含义的用语是有保留的，并指向谨慎表达那一页 |
| 结论 | [Writing conclusions](https://www.phrasebank.manchester.ac.uk/writing-conclusions/) | 先简短回顾，再给出收束判断。该页说明，学位论文比期刊论文更常单独设结论 |

**按句子的功能**（侧栏；核对当天每个链接都打开了页面）：

| 功能 | 页面 |
|---|---|
| 给论断加限定 | [Being cautious](https://www.phrasebank.manchester.ac.uk/using-cautious-language/) |
| 指出已有研究的不足 | [Being critical](https://www.phrasebank.manchester.ac.uk/being-critical/) |
| 分类或列举 | [Classifying and listing](https://www.phrasebank.manchester.ac.uk/classifying-and-listing/) |
| 比较 | [Compare and contrast](https://www.phrasebank.manchester.ac.uk/compare-and-contrast/) |
| 下定义 | [Writing definitions](https://www.phrasebank.manchester.ac.uk/writing-definitions/) |
| 描述趋势 | [Describing trends](https://www.phrasebank.manchester.ac.uk/describing-trends/) |
| 描述数量 | [Describing quantities](https://www.phrasebank.manchester.ac.uk/describing-quantities/) |
| 写原因 | [Explaining cause and effect](https://www.phrasebank.manchester.ac.uk/explaining-cause-and-effect/) |
| 举例子 | [Giving examples](https://www.phrasebank.manchester.ac.uk/giving-examples/) |
| 转到下一点 | [Signalling transition](https://www.phrasebank.manchester.ac.uk/signalling-transition/) |

**在运动科学稿件里怎么用**

1. 打开你正在写的那一部分的页面。先看小标题，决定下一句要完成的事：写缺口、写步骤、写差异，或标出限制。
2. 语法卡住时，取一个短框架。换掉所有示例名词。长度靠近 Davis 与 Morley 讨论的范围。不要整句粘贴后再替换一个变量名。
3. 对这一句再做第 1、第 2 单元的删改。短语库的句子里常有 “it has been shown that” 一类开头。框架用完之后把它们删掉。
4. 把本研究的事实写进句子：测了谁、方案是什么、测了什么、何时测的、结果有多大。改完的句子如果可以原样放进另一篇论文，这一句还没有写完。这个检查在 [`human-voice-en.md` 第 1 节](../../../skills/sportsci-writing/references/human-voice-en.md)。
5. 需要限定语气时，从谨慎表达那一页选一个强度，再用 [`human-voice-en.md` 第 3 节](../../../skills/sportsci-writing/references/human-voice-en.md) 对照证据。只用一个限定。“May potentially suggest” 是三个。
6. 批评已有研究时，写出你在比较的方法或结果。“previous studies have failed to address” 这类空泛的句子，要补上具体缺了什么，否则过不了同一条检查。

两套资料一起用时的顺序：短语库决定这句话要完成的功能，课程规则删空词、恢复动词，技能文件里的具体性和限定语气检查放在段落定稿之前。

## 4. Nature 与 Science 关于主动语态的说明

文章引用了两个页面。2026-11-03 都打开过。只看文章的转述，会和页面现在的文字不一致。

### Nature

现行作者页面：[How to write your paper](https://www.nature.com/nature-portfolio/for-authors/write)（Nature Portfolio）。

核对当天该页的句子是：

> Write clear and direct sentences. Using the active voice ("we performed the experiment...") typically helps readers better understand concepts and results described in a paper.

文章引用的是 Nature Masterclasses 的 [Writing for Greater Impact](https://www.nature.com/masterclasses/writing-for-greater-impact/50732650)（该文自己的标题后面还有 “How to Improve Readability”）。作者栏是 Dr Jeffrey Robens，职务为 Nature Portfolio 的 Head of Community Engagement。该文把下面这句较早的表述归于 Nature：

> Nature journals prefer authors to write in the active voice as experience has shown that readers find concepts and results to be conveyed more clearly if written directly.

核对当天，这句原话不在现行的 “How to write your paper” 页面上。Masterclasses 文章仍把它作为 Nature 的立场印出。看 Nature Portfolio 今天对作者怎么说，用现行作者页。看文章所指的较长说明，用 Masterclasses 这篇。

同一篇文章写了被动仍然有用的四种情况。简要重述：

- 数据没有确定原因。用被动，或用一个不声称因果关系的动词，避免把相关写成效应。文中的例子是低密度脂蛋白胆固醇与地中海饮食。
- 方法部分，重点是技术而不是操作者。文章里“Nature 允许在方法里用被动”这一条，来自这篇 Masterclasses，不是来自现行作者页上的短句。
- 下一句开头需要放读者已经知道的信息，段落才能接下去。
- 偶尔换一种句子。该文建议大约 75% 主动、25% 被动。本仓库不使用这个比例。按目标期刊和技能文件处理。

同一篇文章还要求优先用动词，少把动词做成名词（用 “assess”，少用 “assessment”），并删掉不增加意思的词，包括 “it is well known that”、“as a matter of fact”、“it is worth mentioning that”。它建议把 “it is interesting to note that” 换成 “interestingly” 或 “notably”。用本仓库改稿时不要做这最后一种替换：[ai-traces-en.md](../../../skills/sportsci-writing/references/ai-traces-en.md) 把这类句首副词当作应删除的填充词。删掉开头，留下事实。

### Science

文章引用 [Instructions for preparing an initial manuscript](https://www.science.org/content/page/instructions-preparing-initial-manuscript)，并说该页要求在合适时使用主动语态，例子是写 “we constructed a library”，不要写 “a library was constructed”。

2026-11-03 该页的内容是文件格式、章节顺序、图和 Science 的参考文献体例。抓取到的正文里没有主动语态规则，也没有图书馆这个例子。

文章记住的那句话，在别处被引用为 Science 较早的体例说明。[MedSci Communications](https://medscicommunications.com/2019/12/18/is-passive-voice-passe/) 引用了它，并给出 `http://www.sciencemag.org/about/authors/prep/res/style.dtl`，访问日期为 2009-03-04。引文的意思是：在合适时使用主动语态，尤其是句法需要时；例子是 “To address this possibility, we constructed a λZap library …”，而不是 “To address this possibility, a λZap library was constructed …”。2017 年一份关于本课程第 2 单元 2.2 节的学习笔记引用了同一段 Science 文字：[Kian Meng 的第 2 周笔记](https://www.kianmeng.org/2017/09/coursera-writing-in-sciences-week-2.html)。这些是对旧体例页的转引，不是现行的初稿准备说明。

在 Science 把这条规则放回现行作者页面之前，不要把 2026 年的初稿说明链接当作这句话的出处。投 *Science* 时，格式看现行说明，语态看近期 *Science* 论文。

没有课程视频、幻灯片、讲稿或练习题。没有把短语库条目抄成可以粘贴的清单。没有修改 `ai_trace_check.py`、测试或任何技能文件。

# The workflow, step by step

Each step writes new files. The "check" column is what must be true before the next step starts.

| Step | You bring | The skill produces | Check before moving on |
|---|---|---|---|
| **1 Topic** `sportsci-topic` | an idea, constraints (people, weeks, equipment, ethics), records exported from CNKI / PubMed / Zotero | `topic_card.md`, `design_draft.json`, `topic_data.json` | no red row you cannot explain; effect size has a source; the one sentence on how your study differs is written by you |
| **2 Data** `sportsci-figures` | `design.json` (start from the draft), the data file | `analysis.json`, figures (png + pdf), `tables.xlsx`, `results.docx`, `methods_explained.md` | `check-design` passes; open every figure; `simulated: false` only for real data |
| **3 Writing** `sportsci-writing` | your draft (Chinese or English), `analysis.json` for the numbers | revised text, `ai_trace_check.py` report | every number traceable to `analysis.json`; no invented citation; the checker's hits are fixed or consciously kept |
| **4 References** `sportsci-refs` | the Word file, the reference list, a Zotero collection | `*_Zotero.docx`, `verify` report, `compare` report | every `verify` count is 0; only `word/document.xml` changed; then Word → Zotero → Refresh |

## What passes between steps

```
brief.toml ─┐
records     ├─ topic_card.md
            └─ design_draft.json ──► design.json ──┐
                                      data.csv ────┴─► results.docx · figures · analysis.json
                                                                         │
                                       your own text ◄───────────────────┘ (numbers come from analysis.json)
                                            │
                                            ▼
                                  draft.docx ──► *_Zotero.docx  (live citation fields)
```

## Rules that hold across all four

1. Never invent data, references, effect sizes or results; ask, or say what is missing.
2. Fix the primary outcome before the data are seen.
3. Write a new file, verify it, keep the original.
4. Say which analyses are exploratory and which numbers are illustrative.
5. A heat map or a "gap" is a description of what you have, not a conclusion about the field.

## Using one skill alone

All four work on their own. The only soft dependencies: `sportsci-topic --fetch` uses `sportsci-refs search`, and the topic card's
`design_draft.json` is validated by `sportsci-figures check-design`.

# 运动科学顶刊级作图指南（v4，海军蓝一套，中英文两套语言）
> **配色只有一套：海军蓝。** 色值与角色固定在 `sportsci_figures/pubstyle/style.py`。
> **AI Agent 请从 `SKILL.md` 开始读**；本文只讲设计理由、色板与成图精修规则。

## 一、设计哲学
1. **去杂质化极简边界**：无顶/右边框、刻度朝外、无灰底网格、图例无边框。
2. **克制而有层次的对比色**：海军蓝 + 沙金 + 赤陶，且**角色固定**（见下）。
3. **高信息密度复合图**：`a b c d` 面板由"总体曲线 → 放大 → 差值/估计 → 剂量–反应"咬合。
4. **展示原始数据 + 模型估计 ± 95% CI**：小样本、重复测量设计必须画个体点与连线；估计图取代"柱 + 误差线"。
5. **效应量与不确定性进图**：条件间差值、Hedges g 森林图直接标 95% CI 与精确 P/q；不用星号堆叠。
6. **图与表同源**：图上的估计值与表格来自同一个模型；多重比较方法写进图注/表注。

## 二、色板与语义角色（固定，代码在 `pubstyle/style.py`）
| 角色（代码名） | 色值 | 用法 |
|---|---|---|
| 干预组 / 最高剂量 / 主要结局（`C_PRIMARY`） | **海军蓝** `#112378` | 加粗实线，阴影带 16–20% 透明 |
| 对照组 / 参照条件（`C_CONTROL`） | **沙金** `#C9A66B` | 折线用虚线 |
| "对比"类别 / 有害（`C_CONTRAST`） | **赤陶** `#C4573F` | |
| 中间剂量（`C_MID`） | `#3F4F9E` | 由 `dose_colors(n)` 插值：浅雾蓝 `#9BA5D3` → 海军蓝，亮度单调下降，灰度打印仍可分 |
| 基线访视 / 中性构成 / 参考（`C_SLATE`） | **雾蓝** `#8E98C6` | |
| 第四类别（`C_TEAL`） | 深青 `#2F6F73` | |
| 文本 / 注释 / 个体连线 | 墨色 `#161A26` / `#626778` / `#D5D2CA` | |
连续色阶：纸色 → 海军蓝（`SEQ`）；发散色阶：赤陶 – 纸色 – 海军蓝（`DIVERGING`，相关矩阵、载荷热图用它）。**禁止**：彩虹色、荧光绿、正红/正蓝、默认 matplotlib 循环色、`magma`/`viridis` 等内置色阶。
**唯一的例外：眼动注视热力图**用彩虹类的 `turbo`——这是眼动领域的标准画法，热点必须在照片上看得清。它只是眼动热图函数（`ax_gaze_heatmap` / `fig_gaze_heatmap_grid`）的默认值（常量 `GAZE_CMAP`，可用 `cmap=` 覆盖），不是全局设置；其他所有图（包括画在场地或刺激图上的别的热图）仍然只用海军蓝。
旧代码名 `C_MAGENTA / C_AMBER / C_CORAL` 仍可用，是上述角色的别名（含义是"角色"，色值是蓝 / 沙金 / 赤陶）。

## 三、两套语言（详见 `reference/STYLE_SPEC_ZH.md` / `STYLE_SPEC_EN.md`）
| | 中文集 `apply_style("zh")` | 英文集 `apply_style("en")` |
|---|---|---|
| 图内语言 | 中文标签 + 国际单位 | 全英文，**禁止出现任何汉字**（`save_figure` 会报错） |
| 字体 | Arial（拉丁）+ 微软雅黑/苹方/Noto Sans CJK（汉字，逐字符回退） | Arial |
| 图注/表题 | `图 1  …` / `表 1  …`（学位论文 `图 4-1`） | `Figure 1. …` / `Table 1. …` |
| Word | 宋体 + Times New Roman，标题黑体 | Times New Roman |
**版式、配色、尺寸、统计完全相同。** 字体回退的关键是 `font.family` 写成**列表** `['Arial','Microsoft YaHei']`，不要写 `family='sans-serif'` + 长列表（会让拉丁字符也用中文字体）。

## 四、图的尺寸与字号
单栏 3.5 in（89 mm）/ 双栏 7.2 in（183 mm）；正文 7 pt、刻度 6.5 pt、注释 5.5–6 pt、面板字母 9 pt 粗体；PNG 300 dpi + 矢量 PDF（`pdf.fonttype 42`）。

## 五、图型目录（`sportsci_figures.pubstyle.figures`）
时间过程带 `ax_bands`/`ax_diff_band` · 原始数据 + 估计 `ax_paired_estimate` · 对比森林 `ax_contrast_forest` · 剂量–反应 `ax_dose_response` ·
前后轨迹 `ax_prepost` · 全结局效应量森林 `fig_forest_effects` · 构成条 `ax_stacked_bars` · 日内曲线 `ax_agp` · 散点拟合 `ax_scatter_fit` · 流程图 `draw_flow`。
每种的图片与布局见 `reference/FIGURE_CATALOG.md`；可运行的完整范例见 `examples/pubstyle_demo.py`（同时输出中、英两套）。

## 六、成图精修规则（v4，决定"高级感"）
统计内容不变，下面这些细节让图从"正确"变成"好看"：
* 每个面板 **粗体字母 + 简短标题**（`panel_title`），读者不看图注也知道每块在讲什么；
* 误差线/置信区间一律用**组色**、无端帽，均值点带白边；不要用黑色误差线盖住彩色数据；
* 时间进程画**均值线 + 95% CI 阴影带**，线端直接标组名（自动避让），对照组虚线，不用图例；
* 单个模型对比画成**估计图**（`results.plots.diff_estimate`）：t 抽样分布半小提琴 + 点估计 + 95% CI + 数值，取代只有一行的森林图；
* 云雨图密度平滑收尾并描边，IQR 用细灰线；
* 效应量森林图紧凑化：类别色条、斑马纹行、数值列紧贴坐标轴、"对照/干预更优"置于顶部；
* 长刻度标签自动换行（`wrap_label`），面板宽度按内容分配，`wspace` 约 0.35–0.45。

## 七、避坑清单
* ❌ 默认灰底网格、顶/右边框、带框图例、整图大标题、3D、饼图、彩虹色（眼动注视热力图除外，见上）
* ❌ 黑色误差线压在彩色数据上；只有一行的森林图占整块面板；被截成平头的密度图
* ❌ 英文稿件里出现汉字；用手工翻译中文 PNG 代替重新生成
* ❌ 先画图后 `apply_style`（图会沿用旧字体）
* ❌ 手写结果数字；把 P ≥ 0.05 写成"显著"
* ✅ 面板字母 a b c 粗体小写 + 简短面板标题；直接标注优先于图例
* ✅ 个体数据 + 估计 ± 95% CI；SEM/CI 的含义写明
* ✅ PNG 300 dpi + PDF；模拟数据加"Simulated data"标签

## 八、通用化：26 种数据类型（`examples/gallery/` 与 `reference/DATA_TYPE_GUIDE.md`）
同一套风格覆盖：生理（心肺、HRV、负荷）、神经肌肉与生物力学（肌电、力-时曲线、力-速度、SPM 关节曲线、GRF、IMU、平衡 COP、GPS 追踪）、
运动表现（力量多时点、重测信度、响应者、计时赛、DXA、咖啡因剂量反应）、心理量表（Likert、相关、雷达、中介）、流行病学与诊断（生存、ROC、荟萃分析）、
生物样本（睡眠与可穿戴、生物标志物、组学）以及研究设计（时间线、周期化）。选择规则："按数据的形状选块，风格不变"。

# `sportsci_figures.pubstyle` — API

```python
from sportsci_figures.pubstyle import (apply_style, save_figure, panel_letter, hair_y, fmt_p, t, verify_language,
                                     dose_colors, condition_colors, arm_colors, ResultsDoc,
                                     fmt_num, fmt_msd, fmt_ci, fmt_p_table, fmt_n_pct, save_tables_xlsx,
                                     DOUBLE, SINGLE, C_MAGENTA, C_AMBER, C_CORAL, C_SLATE, C_TEAL, C_INK, C_GREY, C_LIGHT)
from sportsci_figures.pubstyle import figures as pf
```

## style
| Function | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `apply_style(lang)` | `'zh'` or `'en'`. Sets rcParams, fonts (installed fonts only), unicode minus, 300 dpi, TrueType PDF. **Call first.** |
| `save_figure(fig, stem, simulated=True)` | writes `stem.png` (300 dpi) + `stem.pdf`, adds footer tag, closes the figure; raises `ValueError` if an English figure contains CJK |
| `panel_letter(ax, 'a', dx=-0.02, dy=1.04)` | bold lowercase panel label |
| `hair_y(ax)` | faint horizontal dotted grid (the only grid allowed) |
| `fmt_p(p)` | `'P < 0.001'` / `'P = 0.012'` / `'—'` |
| `t(key, lang=None)` | common phrases (`'baseline'`, `'control'`, `'simulated'`, `'disclaimer'`, …) in the active language |
| `dose_colors(n)` | n colours light periwinkle → navy, monotone lightness |
| `condition_colors(names)` | dict: control-like names (`CON`, `control`, `placebo`, `baseline`, …) → control colour; others → ramp in order given |
| `arm_colors(control, intervention)` | `{control: control colour (sand), intervention: primary (navy)}` |
| `verify_language(fig)` | list of CJK strings found in an English figure (empty = OK) |
| `has_cjk_font()` / `font_chain(lang)` | diagnostics |

1. Draw only on the `ax` you receive; take colours from `style.py`; take every text string as an argument (so both languages work).

# Data-type guide — which figure for which data (26 data types, all with a runnable example)

The house style is **data-agnostic**: the same palette, geometry, typography, tables and statistics rules apply to every data type.
What changes is the *figure block*. `examples/gallery/` simulates 26 data types and draws 30 figures in both language sets
(`python examples/gallery/make_gallery.py` → `outputs/gallery/{data,figures}`; rendered copies in `assets/pubstyle_gallery/`).
Take the closest row, copy its function from `examples/gallery/d_*.py`, replace the simulated data.

## 1. Selection rules (follow in this order)

| Your data look like … | Use | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| A curve per participant over time / cycle / distance (CGM, HR, power, EMG envelope, joint angle, GRF, pacing) | `ax_bands` (mean ± SEM, or ± SD for waveform "clouds") + `ax_diff_band` for paired differences | State SEM vs SD. Waveforms on a normalised axis (% cycle, % stance). |
| Two waveforms compared point-by-point | `ax_bands` + `ax_spm` (permutation max-t threshold, shaded clusters) | Never report pointwise P without a field-wise correction. |

# Design spec (`design.json`) — the contract between "design" and "results"

One json file describes the study; the engine needs nothing else besides the data file.
`python cli.py new-design -t <type> -o design.json` writes a runnable template; `python cli.py check-design design.json -d data.csv` validates spec + data;
`python cli.py results design.json -d data.csv -o results_out -l both` produces everything.

```python
from sportsci_figures.results import run_results
run_results("design.json", "data.csv", "results_out", lang="both")      # lang: zh | en | both
```

## Choosing the design

| Study | `design` | Data layout (long, one row per…) | Primary model |
|---|---|---|---|
| Parallel groups, baseline + one follow-up (RCT, quasi-experiment) | `parallel_prepost` | participant × time | ANCOVA (follow-up ~ group + baseline); Hedges g on change |
| Every participant does every condition (random order) | `crossover` | participant × condition | linear mixed model, participant random intercept, period adjusted |
| Parallel groups, ≥ 3 assessments | `multitime` | participant × time | constrained longitudinal LMM (baseline common) or full group × time |
| Pooling published studies | `meta` | study | DerSimonian–Laird + Hartung–Knapp; subgroup; leave-one-out; Egger (k ≥ 10); meta-regression |
| One group, 2 or more assessments (单组前后测 / 单组重复测量) | `single_group` | participant × time | paired t (+ Wilcoxon) / one-way RM-ANOVA, Mauchly + Greenhouse–Geisser, Bonferroni pairwise |
| Questionnaire / cross-sectional survey (问卷调查) | `survey` | respondent (wide: one column per item) | α, KMO/Bartlett, EFA, Harman, correlations, group differences, regression, bootstrap mediation, moderation |

Not sure which design fits a raw data file? `python cli.py intake data.xlsx -o projects/<name>/intake` profiles it and writes `design_draft.json`.

Anything else (waveforms, ROC, survival …): use the figure blocks directly (SKILL.md §4b); this engine is for the analyses where a
pre-registered model + multiplicity rule can be fixed in advance.

## Common fields

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `design` | one of the four above (required) |
| `title` | string or `{"zh":…, "en":…}` |
| `language` | default set when `--lang` is not given |
| `simulated` | `true` → every figure carries "Simulated data" and the docx opens with the disclaimer. **Set `false` only for real data** |
| `columns` | map of roles to data column names (below) |
| `outcomes` | list; **exactly the outcomes you pre-specified**; at least one `"primary": true` |
| `category_labels` | `{category: {"zh":…, "en":…}}` for grouping rows in tables/forests |
| `simulate` | optional block with true effects → `--simulate` generates test data (used by the tests: estimates must recover the truth) |
| `report` | optional `{"profile": "thesis", "chapter": 4}` → Chinese degree-thesis layout: 小四 body, 1.5 spacing, figures/tables numbered 图 4-1 / 表 4-1, headings 4.1, 4.2 … (same as `--chapter 4`) |

Outcome fields: `name` (id), `column` (default = name), `label` (string or zh/en dict), `unit`, `category`, `primary`, `direction` (`higher_better` | `lower_better` | `neutral`; used to orient forest plots so that **positive = favourable**), `decimals`.

Labels may be a plain string (same in both sets) or `{"zh": "...", "en": "..."}`. A label missing in one language falls back to the other — check the English output contains no Chinese (the test-suite does).

## parallel_prepost / multitime
```json
"columns": {"id": "id", "group": "group", "time": "time"},
"groups": {"order": ["CON", "RT"], "control": "CON", "labels": {"CON": {"zh": "对照组", "en": "Control"}, "RT": "RT"}},
"times":  {"order": ["pre", "post"], "primary": "post", "labels": {...}},       // multitime: >= 3 entries; "primary" = time that carries the confirmatory test
"multitime": {"constrained_baseline": true},
"baseline_vars": [{"name": "age", "label": {...}, "type": "cont"}, {"name": "sex", "type": "cat", "levels": ["F", "M"]}]
```
Data: one row per participant per time; outcomes are columns; baseline variables repeated (first row per id is used).

## crossover
```json
"columns": {"id": "id", "condition": "condition", "period": "period"},       // period optional (adjusted when present)
"conditions": {"order": ["CON","RT20","RT30","RT45"], "control": "CON",
               "dose": {"CON":0,"RT20":20,"RT30":30,"RT45":45}, "dose_unit": {"zh":"min","en":"min"},   // dose → linear trend test
               "pairs": [["RT45","RT20"]],                                                                 // pre-specified pairwise contrasts (Holm within outcome)
               "labels": {...}}
```

## meta
```json
"columns": {"study": "study", "n1": "n_int", "m1": "mean_int", "sd1": "sd_int", "n2": "n_ctl", "m2": "mean_ctl", "sd2": "sd_ctl",
            "subgroup": "duration_cat", "moderator": "weeks"},                 // subgroup / moderator optional
"meta": {"effect": "smd",            // smd = Hedges g | md = mean difference | generic = give columns.es and columns.se (or lo + hi)
         "direction": "lower_better",// flips sign so positive = favourable
         "hksj": true, "outcome_label": {...}, "subgroup_label": {...}, "moderator_label": {...}}
```
Extraction template: `config/meta_extraction_template.csv`. For change-score or adjusted effects use `effect: "generic"` with `es` and `se`.

## single_group
```json
"columns": {"id": "id", "time": "time"},
"times": {"order": ["pre", "w4", "w8"], "labels": {...}},       // >= 2 entries
"outcomes": [...]                                              // as above; one "primary": true
```
2 time points: paired t test, mean change (95% CI), d_z, Wilcoxon signed-rank as sensitivity, Shapiro–Wilk on the changes.
≥ 3 time points: one-way repeated-measures ANOVA on complete cases; Mauchly's test; Greenhouse–Geisser-corrected df and P reported whenever
sphericity is rejected (marked †); all pairwise paired t tests with Bonferroni (SPSS default); d_z for last vs first.
The Results text and every table note state that a single-group design cannot attribute change to the intervention alone.

## survey
```json
"columns": {"id": "id"},
"demographics": [{"name": "sex", "label": {...}, "type": "cat", "levels": ["男", "女"], "level_labels": {"男": {"zh": "男", "en": "Male"}}},
                 {"name": "age", "type": "cont"}],
"scales": [{"name": "ANX", "label": {"zh": "焦虑", "en": "Anxiety"}, "items": ["AX1", "AX2", "AX3"], "reverse": ["AX3"], "min": 1, "max": 5, "score": "mean"}],
"common_method_bias": true,                                     // Harman single-factor test
"efa": {"enabled": true, "n_factors": null},                    // null: number of scales (if > 1) else Kaiser
"group_compare": ["sex", "grade"],                              // must be declared in demographics; Welch t / one-way ANOVA, BH q across all
"regression": [{"y": "ANX", "x": ["PA", "SLP"], "covariates": ["sex", "age"]}],
"mediation":  [{"x": "PA", "m": "SLP", "y": "ANX", "covariates": [], "n_boot": 5000, "seed": 7}],   // Hayes model 4, percentile bootstrap
"moderation": [{"x": "PA", "w": "SE", "y": "ANX", "covariates": []}]                                 // Hayes model 1, mean-centred, simple slopes
```
Data: one row per respondent; one column per item (raw answers — reverse-keyed items are recoded by the engine, do not recode them in the file).
Scale scores are added as columns named after the scale, so scale names must not clash with existing columns. Categorical predictors/covariates
are dummy-coded automatically (first level = reference). CFA/SEM are not run (lavaan / AMOS / Mplus); the Results text says so.

## Statistical rules built in (stated in every table note)
- Primary outcome(s): Holm across the contrasts of the primary outcome(s). Secondary outcomes: Benjamini–Hochberg within `category`.
- Between-group effect sizes: Hedges g (parallel; on change scores), paired d_z (crossover). P values: `P < 0.001` / `P = 0.012`.
- Wording ("significant", "was not statistically significant") is chosen by code from the *adjusted* P; non-significance is never written as "equivalent".
- Meta-analysis: τ² DerSimonian–Laird; Hartung–Knapp CI (t, k−1); 95% prediction interval k ≥ 3; Egger only for k ≥ 10 (otherwise stated as not performed).
- Missing data: available-case in ANCOVA; likelihood-based (all available data) in the mixed models.

## Outputs
Every run also writes `<lang>/methods_explained.md`: the defence-style Q&A that explains each analytic choice with the numbers of this analysis
(for learning and defence preparation). `multitime` adds a supplementary group × time mixed ANOVA (SPSS convention).
```
results_out/analysis.json            every estimate (use it to write the Discussion; do not retype numbers)
results_out/design_used.json         the spec as executed
results_out/<zh|en>/figures/*.png|pdf   300 dpi + vector
results_out/<zh|en>/tables.xlsx
results_out/<zh|en>/results.docx     three-line tables, numbered captions
results_out/<zh|en>/results.md       same text/tables, for pasting into other tools
```

## Recipes for common needs (what to call, in what order)

**A. Two-arm RCT, pre/post** → Table 1 (baseline, SMD, P) · Fig `ax_prepost` small multiples · Fig `fig_forest_effects` · Table of all outcomes (`pre/post by arm`, between-group difference (95% CI), P, BH q, Hedges g).

**B. Crossover with time-course outcome** → `fig2` (curves) · `fig3` (primary compound) · secondary panels with `ax_paired_estimate` (2×3 grid) · Table of estimated marginal means · Table of contrasts (difference (95% CI), P, Holm P, d_z).

**C. Continuous monitoring (CGM, HR, power) at group level** → `ax_agp` per arm/visit; composition bars for time-in-zone; individual change slope-graph for the primary metric.

**D. Dose adherence vs response** → `ax_scatter_fit` ×3, one row.

**E. Safety / adverse events** → table only (counts by event × arm); a figure is unnecessary.

## Layout numbers worth keeping
- Compound figure margins come from `bbox_inches="tight"`; do not call `tight_layout` together with `gridspec(hspace=…)`.
- Panel-letter offsets: `dx = −0.04 … −0.2` depending on y-label width; `dy = 1.04 … 1.22` when sub-titles are two lines.
- Legends inside the empty top of a time-course axes: use direct labels at `(x, y)` pairs, 2 columns, keeping ≥ 3 data-units between columns.
- Annotations in the lower-right of axes: `transform=ax.transAxes, ha="right", va="bottom", fontsize=5.5, color=C_GREY`.

# From research gap to `design.json` (the part an AI agent does *before* the results engine)

Goal of the whole chain: **(1)** find a real gap in the literature → **(2)** fix an experimental or meta-analytic design *before* seeing data →
**(3)** run the results engine on the data → **(4)** write Results/Discussion from `analysis.json`.

## 1. Find the gap (no invented references)
1. Search the literature with your usual tools (PubMed, Europe PMC, OpenAlex, Web of Science, CNKI). Read the papers yourself;
   never cite a study you have not read, and verify every DOI before it enters the reference list.
   Without network access, ask the user for PDFs/abstracts — never fabricate citations or effect sizes.
2. Write the gap as one sentence in PICO form: Population, Intervention (dose!), Comparator, Outcome(s). Record 3–5 supporting papers with DOIs.
3. State what result would be *informative either way* (the "so what"): e.g. "no difference between 20 and 45 min" is only a finding with an equivalence margin.

## 2. Pick the design
| Question | Design | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Acute response to several exercise doses/conditions, reversible outcome | `crossover` | each participant is own control; needs washout and randomised order |
| Chronic effect of a programme vs control | `parallel_prepost` | ANCOVA is the efficient, pre-specifiable analysis |
| Time course / durability / dose over weeks | `multitime` | ≥ 3 assessments; constrained baseline model |
| Is there enough evidence yet / how large is the effect across studies | `meta` | pool, explore heterogeneity, assess bias |
| Several phases | write one `design.json` per study (e.g. study 1 crossover, study 2 parallel) |

## 3. Fix the analysis plan in the spec (this *is* pre-registration)
- Exactly one primary outcome (or a small Holm family); everything else `primary: false` with a `category`.
- Orient every outcome with `direction`; set `decimals` and units.
- For crossover add `dose` and `pairs` only if you pre-specify them; for meta set `effect`, `direction`, planned `subgroup` and `moderator` (≤ 2).
- Sample size: compute with the primary contrast and write it in the Methods text (parallel ANCOVA ≈ two-sample t on the adjusted SD; crossover uses SD of the paired difference; meta needs only k).
- Commit `design.json` (and a hash/date in the lab notebook) before data lock.

## 4. Data checklist
- Long format, one row per participant × time (or × condition / per study). Column names exactly as in `columns`.
- `python cli.py check-design design.json -d data.csv` must pass.
- Meta: fill `config/meta_extraction_template.csv` from the papers (two independent extractors if possible); record where each number came from.

## 5. Rehearse before real data (optional but recommended)
Add a `simulate` block with the *plausible* true effects and run `python cli.py results design.json --simulate -l both`. This checks the whole chain,
shows what the paper will look like, and the recovery tests show the estimator is unbiased. Simulated output is stamped "Simulated data" and must never be
presented as evidence.

## 6. After the results
Use `analysis.json` for every number in Discussion/Abstract. Interpret by CI, not only by P; flag secondary outcomes as exploratory; for "no difference" claims
report the CI and, if the claim is equivalence, run an equivalence test against a pre-stated margin.

# English set (`apply_style("en")`)

For English theses, protocols and journal manuscripts (MSSE, BJSM, JSAMS, Diabetes Care …). Layout, colours, geometry and statistics are **identical** to the Chinese set (`STYLE_SPEC_ZH.md`); only language and a few typographic conventions differ. **Every string in figures, tables, captions and notes must be English — `save_figure` raises an error if a CJK character appears in an English figure.**

## 1. Typography
| Object | Rule |
|---|---|
| Figure text | **Arial** (fallback Helvetica / Liberation Sans / DejaVu Sans). `apply_style("en")` configures it; do not override rcParams |
| Sizes | 7 pt body, 6.5 pt ticks, 5.5–6 pt annotations, 9 pt bold lowercase panel letters |
| Word body | Times New Roman 10.5 pt, line spacing 1.35, no first-line indent |
| Word headings | Times New Roman bold: 14 / 12 / 11 pt |
| Figure caption | Below the figure, 8.5 pt: `Figure 1. Title. a, …; b, ….` — the label "Figure 1." is bold |
| Table caption | Above the table, 9.5 pt: `Table 1. Title` — label bold |
| Table note | Below the table, 8 pt grey: model/test, adjustment, multiplicity, abbreviations, transformations (†) |
| Table font | 7–8 pt |
| Punctuation | en dash for ranges (`0–6 h`, `95% CI −6.3 to −3.0`), true minus `−` in figures, thin consistency in text; Oxford comma optional but consistent |
| Spelling | pick British *or* American once (`standardised`/`standardized`) |

## 2. Vocabulary used inside figures (English set)
| Concept | English |
|---|---|
| Baseline / follow-up | Baseline / Week 12 |
| Arms | Control / Intervention (say "waitlist control" in the caption if applicable) |
| Descriptive | Mean ± SD ; Mean ± SEM |
| Time axis | Time after start (h) — state what t = 0 is |
| Change | Change from baseline (unit) |
| Paired difference | Paired difference vs CON (mmol/L) |
| Forest arrows | ← Favours control / Favours intervention → |
| Individual data | "thin lines are individual participants" (caption) |
| Simulated data | `Simulated data` (auto footer, 5 pt grey italic) |

Axis label = **quantity (unit)**: `Glucose (mmol/L)`, `Skeletal muscle mass (kg)`, `14-d TIR (%)`, `0–6 h net iAUC (mmol·h/L)`. Sentence case, no trailing period.

## 3. Numbers and statistics
- Descriptive: `mean ± SD` (2 dp if |x| < 10, 1 dp if < 100, else integer); categorical `n (%)`.
- Estimates: `estimate (95% CI lower, upper)`; in text `−4.3 mmol·h/L (95% CI −6.3 to −2.3; P < 0.001)`.
- P: `P < 0.001` or `P = 0.012`; italic *P* in the final manuscript is applied by the journal template — keep plain text in generated files. Never `P = 0.000` or `P = <0.001`. In tables: `<0.001` / `0.012`.
- Effect sizes: Hedges *g* (between groups), paired *d*z (crossover); say which variable they refer to.
- Multiplicity: Holm for pre-specified contrasts (`Holm P`), Benjamini–Hochberg within outcome category for secondary outcomes (`BH q`), primary outcome unadjusted.
- State coverage thresholds (e.g. CGM ≥ 70% valid data), dropouts, sensitivity analyses.

## 4. Caption template
```
Figure N. {One-sentence title}. a, {content} ({what the band means}); b, {content}; c, {content}.
{Model, adjustment, multiplicity, n, abbreviations.}
```
Example:
```
Figure 3. Primary outcome, 0–6 h net iAUC. a, individual observations (light dots; grey lines join participants with all four conditions)
and linear-mixed-model estimated marginal means with 95% CI; b, differences between conditions with 95% CI (Holm-adjusted P for RT − CON;
dotted line, pre-specified 10% clinical threshold); c, dose–response against CON with linear trend.
```

## 5. Table template
```
Table N. {Title}
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  thick rule
 Outcome | Intervention baseline | Intervention week 12 | … | Between-group difference (95% CI) | P | BH q
────────────────────────────────────────  thin rule under header
 …(no vertical rules, no shading)
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━  thick rule
{Note: Mean ± SD. Between-group difference is the time × group interaction …; BH q adjusted within category; † log-transformed.}
```
- Table 1 reports SMD and the test P value; variables with |SMD| ≥ 0.5 are named in the text and a baseline-adjusted sensitivity analysis is reported.

## 5b. Results sentence templates (English)
| Situation | Template |
|---|---|
| Primary between-group difference | `The intervention group improved {b:.1f} percentage points more than control (95% CI {lo:.1f} to {hi:.1f}; {P}; Hedges g = {g:.2f}); the difference {was / was not} statistically significant.` |
| Crossover main effect | `Across the three band conditions the mean 0–6 h net iAUC was {x:.1f} mmol·h/L lower than CON (95% CI {lo:.1f} to {hi:.1f}; {P}; d_z = {dz:.2f}).` |
| After multiplicity | `After Holm adjustment, RT20 ({b:.1f}; Holm {P}), RT30 (…) and RT45 (…) were each lower than CON.` — use "each" only if all adjusted P < 0.05; otherwise state them separately |
| No detected difference | `RT20 and RT45 differed by {d:+.1f} (95% CI {lo:.1f} to {hi:.1f}; {P}); no difference was detected.` — do **not** claim "equivalent" without an equivalence test |
| Exploratory | `These secondary outcomes were not adjusted for multiplicity and are exploratory.` |
| Baseline imbalance | `Using |SMD| ≥ 0.5, imbalances were present for …; a baseline-adjusted sensitivity analysis is reported.` |
| Safety | `{n} adverse events were recorded across both studies, {s} serious; the most frequent were ….` |

## 6. Do not
- overall figure titles, 3-D, rainbow maps, pie charts, framed legends, default grey grids, neon green / pure red / pure blue
  (the one exception: eye-tracking fixation heat maps use `turbo`, the field's convention; it is the default of the gaze blocks only);
- Chinese (or any non-English) characters anywhere in an English deliverable, including the footer, table cells and docx;
- English figures made by hand-translating Chinese PNGs — regenerate with `apply_style("en")`.

## 7. Conventions by data type (apply to every data type; see `reference/DATA_TYPE_GUIDE.md`)
- **Waveforms / curves** (EMG, joint angle, GRF, pacing): normalised x-axis (% cycle, % stance); mean ± SEM (or ± SD, say which); compare two waveforms with SPM{t} using a permutation threshold, never uncorrected pointwise P values.
- **One value per participant**: paired designs use raw points + joining lines + estimate ± 95% CI; 3 or more groups, or unpaired data, use a raincloud (density, raw points, IQR, mean ± CI) with the density drawn over the observed range only.
- **Questionnaires / ordinal data**: single items as diverging stacked bars (Likert); totals as raincloud or multi-time mean ± 95% CI; correlation matrices as lower triangles with bold = P < 0.05; profiles as radar plots; mediation as a path diagram with a bootstrap interval for the indirect effect.
- **Survival**: Kaplan-Meier with 95% CI bands and censor ticks, a "number at risk" table underneath, hazard-ratio forest on a log axis.
- **Diagnostic / prediction**: ROC (AUC with bootstrap 95% CI, Youden point) and calibration; place the legend below the axes so it never covers a curve.
- **Agreement / reliability**: line of identity with ICC(2,1); Bland-Altman (bias and 95% limits of agreement with CIs); ICC forest annotated with CV%.
- **Meta-analysis**: forest (square area proportional to weight, diamond = pooled), funnel, bubble meta-regression.
- **Omics**: volcano (up primary, down slate), clustered heat map with a group colour strip, PCA scores with 95% ellipses.
- **Log axes**: plain-number ticks (0.5, 1, 2, 4), never 10^n; switch minor tick labels off.
- **Colour**: Likert and correlation matrices use the contrast / slate / primary diverging scale (`DIVERGING`); sequential heat maps use `SEQ` (paper → navy); 5 or more unordered categories use `category_colors(n)`.

# 中文规范（`apply_style("zh")`）

适用：中文学位论文、开题/结题报告、国内期刊的**结果部分**。图、表、图注、表注、正文数字一律按本规范；与英文规范（`STYLE_SPEC_EN.md`）**版式、配色、统计完全相同，只有文字语言和少数排版习惯不同**。

## 1. 字体与排版
| 对象 | 规定 |
|---|---|
| 图内文字 | 拉丁字符与数字用 **Arial**，中文自动回退到 **微软雅黑**（Mac: 苹方；Linux: Noto Sans CJK SC）。`apply_style("zh")` 已配置，**不要覆盖 rcParams** |
| 图内字号 | 正文 7 pt，刻度 6.5 pt，注释 5.5–6 pt，面板字母 9 pt 粗体 |
| Word 正文 | 宋体（中文）+ Times New Roman（数字/字母）10.5 pt，行距 1.35，段首缩进 2 字符 |
| Word 标题 | 黑体：章 14 pt、节 12 pt、小节 11 pt，加粗 |
| 图注 | 图下方，8.5 pt：`图 1  标题。a，…；b，…。` 标签"图 1"黑体加粗，其后两个空格 |
| 表题 | 表上方，9.5 pt：`表 1  标题`，标签黑体加粗；正文宋体不加粗 |
| 表注 | 表下方，8 pt 灰色，写清模型/检验、校正方法、缩写、对数转换（†） |
| 表内字号 | 7–8 pt |
| 标点 | 正文用中文全角标点；数字区间用 `～` 或 `–`（如 `0–6 h`、`−6.3～−3.0`）；小数点用半角 `.` |
| 负号 | 图内用 hyphen-minus（`-`，`apply_style` 已设置）；正文中的负数用 `-` 或 `−` 但全文统一 |

## 2. 图内文字词表（中文集）
| 概念 | 中文 | 备注 |
|---|---|---|
| Baseline / Week 12 | 基线 / 第12周（或 12周） | 图内可用 `12周` |
| Control / Intervention | 对照组 / 干预组 | 等待名单对照写"对照组"，图注说明 |
| Mean ± SD / SEM | 均值 ± SD / 均值 ± SEM | SD/SEM 保留英文缩写 |
| Time after start | 干预开始后时间 (h) | 注明 t=0 |
| Change from baseline | 相对基线变化 | 带单位 |
| Difference vs control | 与 CON 的配对差 | |
| Favours | ← 对照组更优 / 干预组更优 → | 森林图 |
| Individual | 个体 | 图注里写"细线为个体" |
| Simulated data | 模拟数据 · Simulated data | `save_figure` 自动添加，右下角 5 pt 灰色斜体 |

坐标轴标签 = **量名 + (单位)**：`血糖 (mmol/L)`、`骨骼肌量 (kg)`、`14 d TIR (%)`、`0–6 h net iAUC (mmol·h/L)`。时间轴写清含义：`钟表时间（t=0 为 09:30）`。单位一律国际单位制拉丁写法，不译成中文。

## 3. 数字与统计格式
- 描述统计 `均值 ± SD`（保留 1–2 位有效小数，|x|<10 取 2 位，<100 取 1 位，其余取整）；分类变量 `n (%)`。
- 估计值 `估计值 (95% CI 下限, 上限)`；正文写作 `-4.3 mmol·h/L（95% CI -6.3～-2.3，P < 0.001）`。
- P 值：`P < 0.001` 或 `P = 0.012`（三位小数，**不写 0.000、不写 P = <0.001**）。表内列只写 `<0.001` / `0.012`。
- 效应量：Hedges g（组间）、配对 d_z（交叉）；写明基于何种变量。
- 多重比较：预设对比用 Holm，次要结局按类别 BH-FDR，主要结局不校正；校正后的概率分别记作 `Holm P`、`BH q`。
- 缺失/排除：说明 CGM 有效数据比例阈值、脱落人数、敏感性分析。

## 4. 图注模板
```
图 N  {一句话标题}。a，{内容}（{误差带含义}）；b，{内容}；c，{内容}。
{统计与符号说明：模型、校正、阴影/误差线的含义、n、缩写。}
```
示例：
```
图 3  主要结局 0–6 h net iAUC。a，每名受试者在各条件的观测（浅色点；细线连接完成四条件者）与线性混合模型估计边际均值 ± 95% CI；
b，条件间差值及 95% CI（RT − CON 的 P 值为 Holm 校正，虚线为预设的 10% 临床阈值）；c，各剂量较 CON 的变化与线性趋势。
```

## 5. 表格模板
```
表 N  {标题}
┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐  ← 粗线（12 sz）
 指标 | 干预组 基线 | 干预组 第12周 | …| 组间差异 (95% CI) | P | BH q
├─────────────────────────────────────────┤  ← 细线（6 sz）
 …（无竖线、无底纹）
└─────────────────────────────────────────┘  ← 粗线
{表注：均值 ± SD。组间差异为…模型…；BH q 为类别内校正；† 为对数转换。}
```
- 表 1（基线）必须有 SMD 与 P；SMD 绝对值 ≥ 0.5 的变量在正文中点名并说明已做基线调整的敏感性分析。
- 列标题含单位或统计量时写在表头或首列行名里，不在单元格里重复。

## 5b. 结果正文句式（中文）
| 场景 | 句式（花括号内由变量填充） |
|---|---|
| 主要结局组间差 | `干预组较对照组多提高 {b:.1f} 个百分点（95% CI {lo:.1f}～{hi:.1f}，{P}，Hedges g = {g:.2f}），{差异具有统计学意义 / 差异未达统计学意义}。` |
| 交叉主效应 | `三个弹力带条件的平均值较 CON 低 {x:.1f} mmol·h/L（95% CI {lo:.1f}～{hi:.1f}，{P}，配对 d_z = {dz:.2f}）。` |
| 校正后多重比较 | `Holm 校正后，RT20（{b:.1f}，Holm {P}）、RT30（…）、RT45（…）均显著低于 CON。` （仅当三个校正 P 均 <0.05 时用"均显著"，否则逐一陈述） |
| 无差异 | `RT20 与 RT45 相差 {d:+.1f}（95% CI {lo:.1f}～{hi:.1f}，{P}），差异未达统计学意义。` — **不写"无差异"代替"未检出差异"** |
| 探索性 | `此类次要结局未做多重比较校正，仅作探索性描述。` |
| 基线不均衡 | `按 |SMD| ≥ 0.5 判断，存在不均衡的变量有 …，后文对主要结局增加了基线调整的敏感性分析。` |
| 安全性 | `两项研究共记录不良事件 {n} 起，严重不良事件 {s} 起，最常见的为 …。` |

## 6. 禁用与易错
- 禁用：整图大标题、3D、彩虹色、饼图、带边框图例、默认灰底网格、荧光绿/正红/正蓝。唯一例外：眼动注视热力图用 `turbo`（领域标准画法），仅是眼动函数的默认值。
- 图内禁止出现英文长句；缩写（TIR、TAR、HbA1c、SD、SEM、CI）可保留。
- 同一对象全篇同一颜色；剂量顺序用有序色带（浅雾蓝→海军蓝）。
- 中文图用于英文稿件前必须改用英文集重新生成，**不能**靠手工翻译标签。

## 7. 按数据类型的作图约定（所有数据类型通用，见 `reference/DATA_TYPE_GUIDE.md`）
- **波形/曲线**（肌电、关节角、GRF、配速）：横轴归一化（% 周期/% 支撑期），均值 ± SEM（或 ± SD，须注明）；两条波形的差异用 SPM{t}（置换检验阈值）而不是逐点 P。
- **单人单值**：配对设计用"原始点 + 连线 + 估计 ± 95% CI"；≥3 组或不配对用 raincloud（密度 + 原始点 + IQR + 均值 ± CI），密度只画观测范围。
- **量表/等级数据**：单题用分层堆叠条（Likert），总分用 raincloud 或多时点均值 ± 95% CI；相关矩阵用下三角，粗体表示 P<0.05；剖面用雷达图；中介分析画路径图并给出间接效应的 bootstrap 区间。
- **生存分析**：KM 曲线带 95% CI 阴影与删失标记，下方"风险集人数"表，HR 森林图用对数轴。
- **诊断/预测**：ROC（AUC 与 bootstrap 95% CI，Youden 点）、校准图；图例放在坐标轴下方，不遮挡曲线。
- **一致性/信度**：恒等线 + ICC(2,1)，Bland–Altman（偏倚与 95% 一致性界限含 CI），ICC 森林图并标注 CV%。
- **荟萃分析**：森林图（方块面积 ∝ 权重，菱形 = 合并），漏斗图，Meta 回归用气泡图。
- **组学**：火山图（上调主色、下调石板蓝），聚类热图带分组色条，PCA 得分图带 95% 椭圆。
- **对数坐标**：坐标刻度写成普通数字（0.5、1、2、4），不要用 10^n；关闭次刻度标签。
- **配色**：Likert 与相关矩阵使用"对比色/雾蓝/主色"发散色（`DIVERGING`，赤陶–纸色–海军蓝）；序列热图用 `SEQ`（纸色→海军蓝）；≥5 个无序类别用 `category_colors(n)`。

# 文献管理手册：Zotero 接入、引文域、改稿与交付

目标：把一份 Word 文档（学位论文 / 开题报告 / 期刊稿）的引用做到 **引文可自动更新、文献表自洽、版式能交**。
本文件是流水线说明与踩坑记录；代码在 `sportsci_refs/`，命令见 `sportsci-refs --help`。

## 三条铁律

1. **不编造**：作者、年份、卷期页、DOI，一个都不能凭记忆补。缺就问作者或查原文。
2. **域优先**：碰含域的段落，先想“只改一个 run 够不够”，永远不整段替换、不删除含域标记的段落。
3. **先备份再写回，写完必校验**：`sportsci-refs verify` 任何一项不为 0 就地修，不要说“应该没问题”。

## 阶段 0 · 环境探测

```bash
sportsci-refs status
```

| 情况 | 处理 |
|---|---|
| Zotero 未运行 | 请打开 Zotero 桌面端；Zotero 7 需在 设置 → 高级 勾选“允许此计算机上的其他应用程序与 Zotero 通信” |
| 返回 **502 Bad Gateway** | 本机 HTTP 代理（Clash 等）拦截了 127.0.0.1 的请求，**不是 Zotero 故障**——多半是 Zotero 没开。本工具访问本地接口一律绕过代理，访问 Crossref 等外网接口走代理 |
| Zotero MCP | 会话里**真的出现** Zotero 工具才算连上；“配置了”≠“连上了”。没有就直接用本地 HTTP 接口，不要反复重试 |

配置（`config/local.toml`，已被 git 忽略；模板 `config/local.example.toml`，也可用环境变量）：

| 键 | 环境变量 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|
| `zotero_user_id` | `ZOTERO_USER_ID` | 引文 URI `http://zotero.org/users/<id>/items/<KEY>`；在 zotero.org/settings/keys 查看 |
| `zotero_data_dir` | `ZOTERO_DATA_DIR` | 含 `zotero.sqlite` 的数据目录，用于读取数字 itemID |
| `contact_email` | `SPORTSCI_CONTACT_EMAIL` | 可选，Crossref / OpenAlex 的 polite pool |
| `citation_style` | `ZOTERO_CITATION_STYLE` | 学校要求的 CSL 样式（GB/T 7714-2015 数字制或学校指定版本） |

本地 HTTP 接口能力（Zotero 7 实测）：搜索、取 CSL（`?format=csljson` 返回**数组**取 `[0]`）、列分类、`/connector/saveItems` 写入（落在 Zotero 界面里**当前选中**的分类）。
`DELETE / PATCH / PUT` 一律 **501**——接口删不掉、改不了条目。**不要往真实文库写“测试条目”探测权限。**

数字 itemID 不在接口里：`ZoteroLocal.item_ids()` 把 `zotero.sqlite` 连同 `-wal` / `-journal` **拷到临时目录**再读（只拷主文件会丢最近的修改），读完即删。
**绝不直接改 `zotero.sqlite`**：会绕过 `deletedItems` / `syncDeleteLog`，下次同步可能让条目“复活”或搞乱同步状态。

## 阶段 1 · 检索候选、核验 DOI、入库

```bash
sportsci-refs search "resistance training type 2 diabetes HbA1c" --n 15 --year-from 2015 -o 候选.md
sportsci-refs check-doi 候选DOI.txt -o doi核验.md          # 也接受 .ris / CSL .json / GB/T 文本列表
```

- 检索结果是**候选**，不是文献表。“该引哪篇”必须由作者本人读过原文后决定。
- 已自动剔除 Crossref 混入的同行评审记录（`Review for …`、DOI 含 `/review`、`type=peer-review`），这类条目从题名上看不出真假。
- Crossref 的相关性排序弱于 Europe PMC / OpenAlex；中文检索词只在 Crossref / OpenAlex 有效。中文期刊常无 DOI，在知网 / 万方人工核对。
- DOI 核验状态：`OK` / `EXISTS`（有 DOI 无题名可比对，仍可能指向别的论文）/ **`MISMATCH`**（真实 DOI 挂在错误文献上，最隐蔽）/ `404` / `NODOI`。
- 核验只说明“文献存在且元数据一致”，**不说明它支持正文那句话**。

入库：优先用 Zotero 浏览器插件或“按标识符添加”（魔术棒）输入 DOI；已有文献表时见阶段 2。

## 阶段 2 · 已有文献表 → Zotero

稿子里常常已经有一份手打的 GB/T 7714 文献表：

```bash
sportsci-refs parse 文献表.txt -o 文献表            # -> 文献表.ris + 文献表.json，并列出解析不确定的条目
#   Zotero：新建分类并选中 → 文件 → 导入 → 文献表.ris
sportsci-refs check-doi 文献表.ris -o doi核验.md
sportsci-refs match 文献表.txt -c "<分类名>" -o zotero_match.json   # DOI 优先，其次题名相似度 ≥ 0.90；< 0.97 的列入人工复核
```

## 阶段 3 · 纯文本 [n] → Zotero 引文域

```bash
sportsci-refs fieldify 论文.docx -m zotero_match.json --superscript --dry-run   # 先干跑看会转换多少
sportsci-refs fieldify 论文.docx -m zotero_match.json --superscript -o 论文_Zotero.docx
```

然后在 Word 中：Zotero → Document Preferences 选学校要求的样式 → **Refresh**（Zotero 会重排编号、重写文献表并补制表符）。

一个引文域 = 5 个 run：`fldChar(begin)` → `instrText(" ADDIN ZOTERO_ITEM CSL_CITATION {json} ")` → `fldChar(separate)` → 显示 run `[12]` → `fldChar(end)`。
文献表是**一个** `ZOTERO_BIBL` 域，跨越所有条目段落。

实现上的取舍（都来自真实翻车）：

| 坑 | 后果 | 本工具的做法 |
|---|---|---|
| 用 ElementTree 读写整个 `document.xml` 后手动还原根标签 | 内联命名空间（`<a:graphic xmlns:a=…>`）被提到根部、未用声明被删 → Word 报“文件已损坏” | `fieldify` 只对单个 run 做字符串拼接；`fieldedit` 用 lxml，保留全部命名空间声明；其余部件逐字节复制 |

# Method: every rule and threshold

Nothing in `sportsci-topic` is a model or a learned score. Each output is either a count over the student's records, a closed-form or
numerically exact power calculation, or a rule written below. The thresholds are conventions, not laws; they are constants at the top of
`evidence.py` / `feasibility.py` so a supervisor can change them and see the effect on the card.

## 1. Evidence map (`evidence.py`)

**Matching.** Each facet (population P, intervention I, comparator C, outcome O) is a list of terms. A record (title + abstract + keywords,
lower-cased) matches a facet if any term occurs.

- Latin terms are word-bounded, tolerate a plural `s`/`es`, and treat space and hyphen alike (`high-intensity` = `high intensity`).
  So `rt` does not match `start`.
- Chinese terms are plain substrings.

**Counts.** For every combination of the core facets (P, I, O) the number of records matching all of them, over all years and over the
last five (`recent_years`, window ends at `this_year`). *Direct overlap* = P+I+O.

**Overlap tier** (direct overlap in the last 5 years):

| Count | Tier | Colour on the card |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | none | green |
| 1–3 | few | green — state the difference |
| 4–9 | crowded | yellow |
| ≥ 10 | very crowded | red |

**Coverage.** Fewer than 30 records = `low`: the map is a sketch and the evidence check can never be green on it.

**Record-set statements** (only when there is no direct overlap and a pair has ≥ 3 records):

- P+I ≥ 3 and no record has O → "the population/intervention has been studied, none measured this outcome"
- I+O ≥ 3 and none in P → "this intervention/outcome exists, not in this population"
- P+O ≥ 3 and none with I → "this population/outcome exists, not with this intervention"

With direct overlap, the statement is the count itself plus, for effect questions, whether any of those records looks randomised or
quasi-experimental by its title/abstract. All of these are statements about the *record set*, never about the literature.

**Design detection** (title/abstract keywords, first match wins): meta-analysis, review, randomised, crossover, quasi-experimental,
cohort/longitudinal, cross-sectional, survey/questionnaire, pilot, experiment/intervention/trial, other. It is a hint for reading order, not a classification of record quality.

## 2. Design rule table (`designmap.py`)

| Question type | Condition | Design |
|---|---|---|
| synthesis | – | `meta` |
| association | – | `survey` |
| acute | – | `crossover` |
| course | – | `multitime` (warns when fewer than 3 assessments) |
| effect | no control group | `single_group` (warns: change cannot be attributed to the intervention) |
| effect | control, ≥ 3 assessments | `multitime` |
| effect | control, 2 assessments | `parallel_prepost` |

Each rule carries what the design permits, what it forbids, the planned analysis, a simpler fallback, and the statistical comfort it needs
(`basic` < `intermediate` < `advanced`).

## 3. Sample size (`power.py`)

- t tests: exact noncentral-t power. `n_two_sample(d)` is per group; ANCOVA with one baseline covariate uses `d_adj = Δ / (SD·√(1−r²))` and one fewer degree of freedom.
- Paired / crossover / single group: paired t on `dz`. If only `d` is given for a within-subject design it is treated as `dz` (stated on the card).
- Correlation: Fisher z (within ±1 of the exact value). One-way ANOVA: noncentral F, total N rounded up to a multiple of k. Regression: fixed-model noncentral F, λ = f²·N.
- `mdes_*`: the smallest effect with 80 % power at the given n (root of the power function).
- Dropout: `n_enrol = ceil(n / (1 − dropout))`.
- Multiple planned contrasts: Bonferroni on α (`effect.contrasts`).
- Multi-time-point models: no closed form; ANCOVA at the final time point is used and labelled.
- Survey: rules of thumb printed as rules — EFA 5–10 respondents per item and ≥ 200; regression N ≥ 50 + 8·predictors (Green 1991); bootstrap mediation ≥ 200 and no formula.
  If `effect.r` or `effect.f2` is supplied the exact figure is also computed and the larger of the two is used.
- Meta-analysis: k ≥ 2 can be pooled, funnel plot and meta-regression need ≥ 10 studies (Cochrane Handbook). The "sample size" is the number of eligible studies.
- **Sensitivity table**: n for d (or dz, r) = 0.3 / 0.5 / 0.8 and the power at the accessible n. Labelled as conventional magnitudes, never as the student's effect size.

Values are checked in `tests/test_topic.py` against widely published G*Power results (d = 0.5 → 64 per group; dz = 0.5 → 34; f = 0.25, k = 3 → 159; f² = 0.15, 3 predictors → 77).

## 4. Feasibility rubric (`feasibility.py`)

| Check | Green | Yellow | Red |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sample | power at accessible n ≥ 0.80 and effect source stated | 0.60–0.80, or no effect source, or no effect size | < 0.60 |
| Time | slack ≥ 20 % of weeks needed | slack < 20 % (or no deadline given) | weeks needed > weeks available |
| Measures | every outcome with `needs` has the instrument | a secondary outcome lacks it | the primary outcome lacks it |
| Ethics | approved / not needed | pending / not started / minors or patients | not started *and* time check red |
| Analysis | planned analysis within stated comfort | one level above | two levels above (use the fallback) |
| Design | no warning | a design rule warned (e.g. no control group) | – |
| Overlap | tier none / few and coverage ok | crowded, or fewer than 30 records, or no records | very crowded |

**Weeks needed** = ethics (approved 0, pending 4, not started 8, overridable by `ethics_weeks`) + recruitment + intervention + testing + analysis and writing.

**Overall colour** = the worst row. There is deliberately no weighted score: a red is a red and the student sees which constraint it is.

## 5. Variants (`variants.py`)

One axis of the brief is replaced by a listed alternative, the direct overlap is recounted, and the difference to the base question is shown.
With `--two-axis`, alternatives from two different axes are combined (capped at 40 rows).
A variant is **not assessable** if its own terms match no record at all: a zero then reflects the record set, not the field.
Ranking: assessable variants with the fewest recent direct overlaps first, then all-years overlap, then the unassessable ones.
A variant changes who can be recruited, what is measured and the ethics route; the table says nothing about those.

## 6. What the tool cannot do

- It cannot tell that a topic is *important* or *interesting*. It tells whether it is crowded, possible and affordable.
- It does not read papers. A record that mentions all three facets in the abstract may still study something else.
- It cannot search CNKI automatically. Records from CNKI / Wanfang are exported by the student.
- It cannot replace the supervisor's or the ethics committee's judgement.

This is a hard checklist, not a style suggestion. If polished output contains any of these patterns, the job is not done: rewrite.

Each entry gives **AI version → human version**. Imitate the human version.

This file only tells you what to remove. Clean text can still read as generated. After this checklist, run the positive check in `references/human-voice-en.md`.

## 1. Punctuation overuse

### 1.1 Em-dashes as parenthetical inserts

The single most reliable AI tell in English. Sport science journals rarely use em-dashes this way. They belong to magazine writing.

- ❌ High-intensity interval training — a method that has gained increasing attention in recent years — significantly improves VO2max.
- ✅ High-intensity interval training, which has gained attention in recent years, significantly improves VO2max.
- ✅ High-intensity interval training significantly improves VO2max. This method has gained attention in recent years.

**Rule (author's zero-tolerance list, SKILL.md principle 2):** polished output contains no dashes used as asides. That covers the em-dash `—`, a spaced en-dash ` – `, a double hyphen `--`, and a spaced hyphen ` - `. The only allowed dash is the unspaced en-dash in ranges and compounds: `60–80%`, `weeks 1–4`, `muscle–bone unit`.

### 1.2 Parentheses as qualifying asides

AI loves to drop hedges and clarifications into parentheses. In a journal article, parentheses should hold: abbreviation expansions, units, statistical values, citations. If a parenthetical contains a qualification or commentary, fold it into the sentence or drop it.

- ❌ Participants (all male university students) completed three trials (each separated by 48 h).
- ✅ Thirty male university students completed three trials separated by 48 h.

Acceptable parentheses:
- maximal oxygen uptake (VO2max): abbreviation
- heart rate (beats·min⁻¹): units
- (P < 0.05): statistic
- (Smith et al., 2021): citation

### 1.3 Serial comma chains of nouns

- ❌ We measured heart rate, blood pressure, lactate, cortisol, testosterone, creatine kinase, leukocyte count, and IgA.
- ✅ We measured cardiovascular variables (heart rate, blood pressure), metabolic and endocrine markers (lactate, cortisol, testosterone, creatine kinase), and immune markers (leukocyte count, IgA).

Group long lists into categories.

`First, … Second, … Third, … Finally, …` at the start of consecutive sentences or paragraphs is the second-most-reliable AI tell. It is allowed once per Discussion if the structure genuinely calls for it, and never as a section-by-section template.

- ✅ After baseline testing, participants completed 8 weeks of training. All variables were then re-measured and analyzed.
